answer: Like a subterranean mycelium weaving scarce nutrients into fruitbodies, decentralized consensus crystallizes economic trust from genuine computational entanglement. Under transitive trust flow, an attacker at the network nadir attempting to spawn phantom nodes faces superlinear verification costs: every Sybil branch demands polynomial staking and cross-cluster proofs. Stray impostors burn out like a fleeting comet against the collective kernel of peer validations.
